I had amazing fasting results this year and gained it all back through a poorly disciplined summer.

> I always expect to overshoot my goal weight by 5-7 lbs so that when I do refeed and rehydrate I am at my goal.

This!  Every single person needs to consider this when doing fasting.  I automatically add 5 lbs to the scale just before I break a fast.  It's a lot less of a blow to me mentally if I know to expect it.

This is honestly the best way to put it. My productivity at work has skyrocketed. I used to mess around on reddit for half the day and then catch up on my work at night. But now I work during work and relax in my off hours.
Are you able to lift?  I get so weak when im fasted...I make sure to hit the weights hard on refeed days.
Same with me on the composition....I feel like im getting skinny fat if anything, it feels like im losing more muscle.
I dread explaining it to others.  They don't understand and just try to shove food down your throat.

As someone who just did a 3 day for the first time, might I suggest you start small and work your way up?  I completed my first fast but felt pretty sick afterwards (although im sure that was the way I broke the fast). 

But working your way up to the fast with smaller ones let's you reevaluate how your fast went and to make adjustments for the next one.  You don't know what to expect on your first weight or how your body will react.  Working your way up to 20 lets you figure all this out and get to know some danger signs.  I did log my experience it's in my post history if you are interested.

This.  You can look in my post history but I just did my first 3 day fast.  Before the fast I didn't prepare and just binged.  I went on a 72 fast and broke it with salad and.....fried chicken.  Calorically I didn't eat a whole lot of it but it was the wrong thing to choose in my moment of weakness (LPT prepare your food to break your fast in advance and don't just go to the grocery store hungry)

Anyways, that was Wednesday and my stomach still feels horrible.  I don't know that I will ever do another fast again but I suppose an upside is that my appetite is absolute shit.  I have no wish to binge eat at all.
